changelog: Trends counts an ask for each item a shopper asks for, a repeat of an open request too (once a day per request, so re-posting can't swell it), so demand isn't undercounted. Confirmations still count only new requests. The 1.3.0 backfill can't see repeats from before it.

The vendor digest and the vendor dashboard page name each item as its translation in the vendor's language (WPML, Polylang), falling back to the original. The digest's templates take a $names map (@version 1.3.1).
The shop's demand digest ends with "And N more items." when it lists 20 of more; its templates take $more (@version 1.3.1).
Uninstall removes WooCommerce's saved settings for the plugin's six emails (woocommerce_crestock_*_settings).
The release workflow checks that RELEASES_TOKEN itself can write to the releases repo (a refused, invalid ref creation: 422 means it may), not its owner's role.
